description: Least-privilege surface for the Bar panel webview. It can call the read-only bar_snapshot command, the fixed-target bar_action click command and the on-demand bar_weather and bar_media_artwork commands, and the bar_session_action command (Pause/Resume of keepAwake only) (all ACL-gated to this capability; each also authorizes the calling window label itself) and listen for the host's bar-changed event. No close, drag, filesystem, shell, opener, dialog, HTTP, system or plugin permissions are granted.
